DEMOLITION RESPONSE UNIT 7
MELTDOWN EXPRESS

HARBOR BREAK — a one-level vertical slice. A Blast Corps–inspired clearance action game.

The autonomous fusion rig MELTDOWN EXPRESS is overheating and rolling unstoppable toward the coolant plant. Everything in its corridor — warehouses, containers, tenements — must go. Ram it, bulldoze it, blast it. If the Express is blocked too long, its hull fails and the harbor goes up.

🟡 MULE-9 BULLDOZER
Slow, unstoppable. Flattens anything.
🔵 RHINO TIPPER
Heavy ram. Fast enough, hits hard.
🟢 JACKRABBIT BUGGY
Scout. Fast, fragile, shoves small junk.
